_about: Hand-curated IIQ -> ISC mapping used by analyze_iiq.py. Levels: direct (same concept, small changes), adapt (an ISC equivalent exists but the logic must be rewritten or reshaped), none (no ISC equivalent: redesign). Checked 2026-11-15; see ../references/mapping.md for the reasons and sources.

BuildMap.isc: BuildMap connector rule (Delimited File / JDBC sources), POST /connector-rules/v1
BuildMap.why: Same purpose; runs on the VA, no context, no platform queries.

JDBCBuildMap.why: Same purpose; use the supplied connection only.

JDBCProvision.why: Same purpose; use the supplied connection, no context.

JDBCOperationProvisioning.isc: JDBCProvision connector rule (one rule handling all operations)
JDBCOperationProvisioning.why: ISC documents a single JDBCProvision rule; split per-operation logic inside it.

WebServiceBeforeOperationRule.isc: WebServiceBeforeOperationRule connector rule (or a SaaS connector customizer for SaaS sources)

ConnectorAfterCreate.why: Same before/after IQService rules exist in ISC.

Correlation.isc: Source correlation config (attribute pairs, Equals); only if impossible a Correlation cloud rule
Correlation.why: Most IIQ correlation rules are attribute matches the correlation config does without code; the cloud rule cannot use context and returns identityAttributeName/Value.

ManagerCorrelation.isc: managerCorrelationMapping on the source; else a ManagerCorrelation cloud rule
ManagerCorrelation.why: Simple mappings need no rule in ISC.

IdentityCreation.isc: Identity profile attribute mappings with transforms
IdentityCreation.why: ISC has no creation rule; identity attributes are computed by the identity profile on every refresh.

IdentityAttribute.isc: Transform on the identity profile mapping (preferred) or an IdentityAttribute cloud rule
IdentityAttribute.why: Transforms cover most logic and need no SailPoint review.

IdentityAttributeTarget.isc: Attribute sync (identity attribute mapped in the source's Create Account) or a workflow
IdentityAttributeTarget.why: Target rules have no ISC equivalent; attribute sync propagates identity attribute changes.

ResourceObjectCustomization.isc: Transforms on identity attributes; BuildMap for file/JDBC sources; connector customizer for SaaS sources
ResourceObjectCustomization.why: No customization rule in ISC: change values where they are used, or in the connector.

ManagedAttributeCustomization.isc: Entitlement metadata via the entitlements API / import, owners and requestability on access profiles
ManagedAttributeCustomization.why: No managed-attribute customization rule in ISC.

BeforeProvisioning.why: Same purpose; rewrite context/Provisioner calls with idn helpers or drop them.

AfterProvisioning.isc: Workflow on the Provisioning Completed event trigger
AfterProvisioning.why: ISC has no AfterProvisioning rule; react to provisioning events in a workflow.

Integration.why: Deprecated in ISC; SailPoint points to BeforeProvisioning.

FieldValue.isc: Create Account field with a transform; AttributeGenerator cloud rule for uniqueness or complex logic
FieldValue.why: Provisioning policy fields map to the create profile; uniqueness belongs in an AttributeGenerator rule.

AllowedValues.isc: ISC Forms (static options or form conditions)
AllowedValues.why: No scripted allowed-values in ISC forms.

Validation.isc: ISC Forms validations (built-in), or workflow checks
Validation.why: No scripted validation rules in ISC forms.

Workflow.isc: ISC Workflows (triggers, actions, operators) or event triggers to your own service
Workflow.why: IIQ workflow BeanShell does not run in ISC; rebuild the steps with workflow actions.

CertificationExclusion.why: Deprecated in ISC; SailPoint points to campaign filters.

IdentitySelector.isc: Role membership criteria (standard or identity list)
IdentitySelector.why: Deprecated in ISC; SailPoint points to role standard assignment criteria.

PreIterate.isc: Prepare the file before upload (outside ISC)
PreIterate.why: Not a supported ISC rule type.

PostIterate.isc: Handle the file after upload (outside ISC)
PostIterate.why: Not a supported ISC rule type.

MergeMaps.isc: Delimited File merge settings on the source, or merge before upload
MergeMaps.why: Not a supported ISC rule type.

Refresh.isc: Transforms, lifecycle states and workflows (identity refresh is automatic)

Policy.why: Scripted policy rules are not supported.

Violation.isc: SOD policy violation handling in ISC (built in)

Approver.isc: Access request approval config, governance groups, or a dynamic approver via the Access Request Dynamic Approval trigger
Approver.why: Approver logic moves to configuration or an event trigger.

Owner.isc: Set owners explicitly on sources, roles, access profiles, entitlements

TaskCompletion.isc: Workflow on the relevant event trigger, or monitor via API

EmailRecipient.isc: Notification template recipients / workflow Send Email action

RequestObjectSelector.isc: Access request configuration and requestable flags on access profiles/roles

Certifier.isc: Campaign reviewer options (manager, source owner, search, reviewer per item via search campaigns)
Certifier.why: No certifier rules; choose a campaign type.

ListenerRule.isc: Event triggers (Identity Attributes Changed, ...) to a workflow or external service

_default.isc: No documented ISC equivalent: redesign with transforms, workflows, event triggers or external services
_default.why: Rule type not supported in ISC.

Application.isc: Source (VA-based or SaaS connector), account schema, correlation config, create profile, aggregation schedule
Application.why: Connector settings, schema and correlation move; rules attached to the application are mapped one by one.

Workflow.isc: ISC Workflows (event/scheduled/external triggers, actions) and access request configuration
Workflow.why: IIQ workflow steps and scripts are rebuilt; LCM workflows map to access request settings plus workflows.

Form.isc: ISC Forms (form definitions), used from workflows
Form.why: Static fields move; scripts (AllowedValues, Validation, FieldValue) do not.

Bundle.isc: Role (business) or Access profile (IT role / entitlement bundle); membership criteria for assignment rules
Bundle.why: ISC roles contain access profiles and entitlements; IIQ role hierarchy and permitted/required roles must be flattened.

Policy.isc: SOD policy (conflicting access on entitlements/access profiles/roles)
Policy.why: SOD and role SOD map; advanced, entitlement-scripted and activity policies do not.

CertificationDefinition.isc: Certification campaign (manager, source owner, search, role composition, machine account) with campaign filters
CertificationDefinition.why: Campaign types differ; exclusions become filters.

TaskDefinition.isc: Aggregation schedules on sources; identity refresh is event-driven; custom tasks become scheduled workflows or external jobs using the API
TaskDefinition.why: No custom task executors in ISC.

TaskSchedule.isc: Source aggregation schedules or scheduled workflows

QuickLink.isc: Request Center for access, Forms + workflows (external trigger) for custom actions

Custom.isc: Transform lookup tables, identity/source attributes, or an external store called from workflows
Custom.why: Custom objects are not supported in ISC.

Plugin.isc: External application on the ISC APIs (UI Development Kit)
Plugin.why: IIQ plugins are not supported in ISC.

EmailTemplate.isc: Notification templates (Velocity; different variables) or workflow Send Email
EmailTemplate.why: Template variables and the set of emails differ.

ObjectConfig.isc: Identity attributes and identity profile mappings (with transforms)
ObjectConfig.why: Identity attribute definitions and sources move; rules on them become transforms.

IdentityTrigger.isc: Lifecycle states, workflows on Identity Created / Identity Attributes Changed triggers
IdentityTrigger.why: Lifecycle events become lifecycle states and event-triggered workflows.

Capability.isc: User levels and custom user levels / RBAC

AuditConfig.isc: ISC audit events and search (built in)

Configuration.isc: Tenant settings in the admin UI / API

applicationTypes.Web Services: Web Services (VA) or a SaaS custom connector
applicationTypes.Logical: No logical applications in ISC: model with roles/access profiles
